# Sanderling Boatyard - harbour return

The counter book has one row for each day the yard runs the tractor to the water and
records every hull that goes into the water that day. A hull that comes out for
work and goes back in on a later day is written on the day it goes in again.

turns.prompt: Sanderling Boatyard is closing the September figures for the harbour dues return. How many hulls went into the water over September 2026? Give the number alone, as digits, with no label. Reply with only the final answer. If you cannot determine the answer, reply exactly UNKNOWN.
